scenario.title: Flying-lap reference capture, balanced starter, Riviera Run
scenario.description: One calibration-driver run capturing the flying-lap reference for car.balanced_starter (currently displayed as Comet) at stock loadout with Standard assists. The tactical opportunity-window protocol does not apply and is omitted.

reference_records.title: Planned flying-lap reference record, balanced starter, Riviera Run
reference_records.description: Capture plan for the five clean flying laps that establish the balanced starter's reference profile on Riviera Run. Results are deliberately absent: this record becomes measured only when M1/M4 tooling captures the laps against exactly these dependencies. The initial Bronze/Silver/Gold thresholds are 1.25/1.12/1.05 times the measured flying-lap median once it exists.

expectations.statement: The fixture family equals the enclosed scenario's family.
A reference_lap_capture scenario omits the tactical opportunity-window members.
The scenario declares the full reference-capture telemetry minimum: gate crossings, lap times, sector splits, speed samples, contacts, resets, progress corrections and validity flags.
The embedded record is planned and carries no laps, statistics, hashes or thresholds.
The capture protocol rejects runs with contacts, reset, missed gates, invalid progress or numerical errors - all five criteria.
Every null (unratified revisions, unrecorded platform, warm-up count, all results and thresholds) has a matching unknowns entry.
No comparison metric claims measured status; the medal factors are documented initial targets.
The content hash recomputes over canonical JSON with the content_hash member removed.
